caseNameFull: Carrie M. Ward, in Error v. Cleveland Trust Company

opinions.text: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of. Ohio. Motion to docket and dismiss submitted May 16, 1904. Decided May 31, 1904. Motion to docket and dismiss granted, and case docketed and dismissed with costs. Mr. James Rudolph Garfield for defendants in error in support . of motion. No one opposing.
